description: Upcoming football matches in a city or a country between two dates, with the cheapest ticket price we hold. Accepts exactly one of city or country. Supports filters for budget, men's or women's football, senior, reserve or youth sides, and top competitions. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

city.description: A city, for example Lisbon. Omit when naming a country.

country.description: A country, for example Portugal. Omit when naming a city.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Today unless given.

gender.description: men or women: who plays. Leaves out competitions classified the other way.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 20 unless given, at most 50.

maxPrice.description: Keep only matches whose cheapest ticket costs at most this. The budget is compared with every ticket at today's exchange rate; a match priced only in a currency with no rate is kept and marked priceNotConverted, and a match with no price is left out.

amount.description: The most the visitor will pay for one ticket.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of that amount, for example EUR or GBP.

squad.description: senior, reserve or youth: which side plays. Leaves out competitions classified otherwise.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, any date ahead. 7 days after the first unless given, and at most 31 days after it.

topRanksOnly.description: True to keep only the matches of the highest-ranked competitions found, for example the top division rather than the lower leagues. Friendlies are left out.

name: find_matches
title: Find football matches
